name: tau2-eval
description: Higher-order harness: runs a tau2-bench evaluation *inside* a live Claude Code session. The session is the agent-under-test (load a domain harness plugin alongside this one); a Stop hook plays the tau2 user-simulator, driving the conversation turn by turn until the user is done, then the run is scored with tau2's canonical evaluator. Domain-agnostic — pair it with any tau2 domain harness plugin. See harnesses/docs/higher-order-harness.md.
